intent_contract.text: 항공기 화장실 스튜어디스 허벅지 키워드로 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘

A tasteful, subtly sensual fashion-editorial photograph of an adult female flight attendant in a recognizable aircraft lavatory, with the composition emphasizing her thighs while preserving a believable professional uniform and setting.

Create a cinematic fashion photograph inside a compact commercial-aircraft lavatory. An unmistakably adult female flight attendant wears a tailored navy cabin uniform with a fitted blazer, crisp blouse, neck scarf, and short structured skirt. She steadies herself beside the tiny sink during a gentle bank, one knee bent and her weight shifted naturally, while glancing at her reflection with calm professional composure. Use a waist-to-knee composition that makes her thighs the dominant foreground form, balanced by recognizable lavatory details: curved wall panels, latch, mirror, folded paper towels, and brushed-metal fixtures. Cool overhead cabin light mixes with a soft warm mirror glow, creating realistic skin texture and restrained highlights on fabric. Shoot at close range with a 35 mm documentary-fashion perspective, slight diagonal geometry, shallow but credible depth of field, fine grain, and polished magazine realism. The mood is intimate, poised, and subtly sensual, with believable proportions, gentle aircraft vibration, and an unbranded contemporary interior.

A helmet, flight suit, badge, mecha cockpit, or generic instrument wall alone does not substitute for aircraft operation.
